posts.subject: Addition to rules
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


Me and @WHAT came against problem of usually being targeted by detectives nearly every round which kills the fun of being a Traitor as you get tasered every time.

polls.question: *NEW* - Detectives are not allowed to target a player.

By that, I mean that the detective is always looking to prove you first which is indeed ruining the fun so this is how you loose players because if every time, they are focused, they will simply leave.


Second of all, the reputation of the server would no be at risk. I don't even understand this point, when you play on a server, you play by the rules so one more or one less rule change nothing because the players have to respect it.


Then, I would like you @Mas0n to act neutral in that kind of stuff because right now, you are not acting neutral, you let your feeling alter you judgment. I'm not saying you are wrong, I just want you to stay neutral and don't let yourself start something bad.


At the end, this suggestion would not be a personal privilege but a improvement for the server.


In conclusion, I have to say that I am for this rule and it's always nice to see people like @Al Capone to suggest stuff.
